title: Is this how sports fans felt when Michael Jordan quit basketball? #De...
transcript: Can someone please explain to me what a Savannah banana is? Because I've never been more confused by an announcement than Derek Lena announcing that he is joining this baseball team. Because I know Derek Lena from the Broadway from shows like wicked and Moulin Rouge, and it never really occurred to me that he could just stop doing that. Like, I just assumed that he was next in line for the Gatsby throne. What is he doing on a baseball team? Is he going to sing on said baseball team? Because his announcement video was a song parody of go the distance from Hercules. Because if this is like a singing dancing baseball team, I'm in. Say less. I'm there every game. Like, I would find baseball so much more enjoyable if between innings they stopped and did a full production number of I don't dance from High School Musical 2. But if he's just playing baseball, then like, I don't really know if I will like that. So my question to you is what is a Savannah Banana? And would I, someone who is very much a musical theater fan, very much not a sports or baseball fan, enjoy watching them play? And also, why is Derek Clena there? Does anyone know?
classificationReason: Commentary about Broadway performer Derek Klena joining the Savannah Bananas baseball team. Mentions Wicked/Moulin Rouge/Gatsby only as background; no specific stage production is being reviewed or commented on.
